title: At the Doctor's / Na mokambi ya dokté
bridge: Na español, po na kosala ete tozali na nguya tosilaka 'me duele' + se ya mwili (me duele la cabeza). Na anglais, lisolo ezali moko: 'I have' + 'a headache' (nazali na nguya ya ntama). Ezali eloko ya mposa mpo tokoki koloba 'I hurt my head' po na nguya ya ntama. Kasi, na anglais, 'hurt' esalemi lokola dongó: 'My head hurts' (ntama na ngai ezali na nguya). Koyeba kosala 'have' na makambo ya komona nguya mpe 'hurt' na bato ezali mposa po kozala na ndembo ya kozala lokola moto ya yango.
rule: Po kozala na ndembo ya A2 na anglais, tosilaka: 1) 'I have' + nkombo (a headache, a cold, a fever, a cough, a sore throat, a stomachache, etc.) po koloba ete ozali na ete. 2) 'My [se ya mwili] hurts' to 'My [se ya mwili] is sore' po koloba ete ozali na nguya na se ya mwili. 3) 'I feel' + nkombo ya ndenge (sick, dizzy, tired, etc.) po makambo ya ndenge. Na biloko mpe ndakisa, tosilaka 'do/does' (Do you have...? Yes, I do. No, I don't). Po makambo ya kosala, tosilaka 'should' / 'shouldn't' (You should rest, You shouldn't eat spicy food). Boya ete 'hurt' ezali dongó ya kozala na ndenge ya kozala: hurt - hurt - hurt. Tokoki koloba 'me duele' ndenge ya kozala; tozali na kozala: 'My head hurts' (kasi 'I hurt my head' kaka po na likambo ya kozala). Mpe ezali ya ndenge 'I've got' lokola ndenge ya 'I have got' (I've got a cold). Na makambo ya kozala, tosilaka 'I have a cold'.

concept_examples.text: I have a headache and a sore throat.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na nguya ya ntama mpe ya kolya.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈhɛdeɪk ənd ə sɔːr θroʊt/

concept_examples.text: My stomach hurts after eating.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na nguya ya ngumba na nsima ya kolya.

concept_examples.text: Do you have a fever?
concept_examples.translation: Ozali na mbuka?

concept_examples.text: You should drink a lot of water.
concept_examples.translation: Ozala kosala mpenza ya mai mpenza.
concept_examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd drɪŋk ə lɒt əv ˈwɔːtər/

common_error.explanation: Likolo ezali na kozala 'me duele la cabeza' lokola 'I hurt my head'. Kasi 'hurt' lokola dongó ya kozala ezali na kozala (nazali na nguya ya ntama). Po na nguya ya ntama, tosilaka 'have a headache' to 'my head hurts'. Boya: 'hurt' lokola dongó ya kozala (kozala na ete) ezali na kozala, kasi na se ya mwili (my head hurts). Boya kozala 'have' + nkombo po na makambo ya kozala.

examples.original: I have a cold.
examples.translation: Nazali na mbula.
examples.note: Silaka 'have' + makambo to ndenge ya kozala. Kosi koloba 'I am cold' po mbula, ezali na kozala ete ozali na mbula.

examples.original: I have a cough and a runny nose.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə kɒf ænd ə ˈrʌni noʊz/
examples.translation: Nazali na kosenga mpe na kosenga ya ntama.
examples.note: Ndenge ya kozala na 'and' ezali ya ndenge: cough and runny nose. Boya 'runny nose' (ntama ya kozala).

examples.original: I feel dizzy.
examples.translation: Nazali na ndenge ya kozala.
examples.note: 'Feel' + nkombo ya ndenge po makambo ya mwili. Na español tosilaka 'me siento', kasi na anglais kosi 'I feel me'.

examples.original: Take this medicine twice a day.
examples.translation: Toma yango ya mpona zomi mibali na mbula.
examples.note: Dongó 'take' esalemi na yango, kosi 'drink' (kolya). 'Twice a day' ezali mibali na mbula.

examples.original: You should rest in bed.
examples.translation: Ozala kosala na likolo.
examples.note: Po na ndakisa, 'should' + dongó ya kozala. Ezali mpenza ya 'must' (kozala).

examples.original: I need to make an appointment.
examples.translation: Nazali na kozala na mokambi.
examples.note: Silaka 'make an appointment' po na mokambi. 'Need to' + dongó ezali na kozala.

examples.original: My back hurts a lot.
examples.translation: Nazali na nguya mpenza ya ngumba.
examples.note: 'A lot' na nsima to na nsima ya dongó. Kosi koloba 'my back hurts much' kozala 'a'.

examples.original: I have a sharp pain in my chest.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ʃɑːrp peɪn ɪn maɪ tʃɛst/
examples.translation: Nazali na nguya mpenza ya ntama.
examples.note: Silaka 'sharp' po nguya mpenza mpe 'dull' po nguya ya ntama. Koloba se ya mwili na 'in my + se ya mwili'.

examples.original: My knee is swollen and red.
examples.translation: Sango na ngai ezali ya ntama mpe ya ntama.
examples.note: Silaka 'is' + nkombo ya ndenge po na ndenge. Boya ete 'swollen' ezali nkombo ya ndenge ya kozala.

title: Booking Accommodation / Kóma boye
bridge: Na espanyol, tozali kozonga lisusu na motó ya 'réserver' (nakómi nsé ya mobali), kasi na anglais bazali kozonga na 'would like' na 'to book' mpo na bobelema. Kasi ezali mpenza na kozala na lokumu na prépositions: na espanyol tozali koloba 'chambre double' na adjectif na nsuka, kasi na anglais adjectif ezali kokóma na liboso ('double room'). Kasi na anglais tozali kozonga 'for' mpo na kozonga ntango ('for two nights'), kasi na espanyol tozali koloba 'por dos noches'.
rule: Mpo na kóma boye na anglais na niveau A2, zongela mituna oyo eleki: 'I would like to book...' (Nakómi nsé ya mobali...), 'I'd like to make a reservation' (Nakómi nsé ya mobali). Kozonga présent simple mpo na kozonga biloko oyo ezali ya yo: 'My name is...'. Mpo na dates, zongela 'on' na biléyo ('on Monday') na 'for' na ntango ('for three nights'). Mpo na kozonga elongo, zongela 'Do you have...?' (Bazali na...) to 'Is there...?' (Ezali...). Biloko oyo tozali kozonga na chambre: 'single room' (chambre moke), 'double room' (chambre mibale), 'twin room' (chambre na bobele mibale). Kosala na mokili ete na anglais ordre ezali adjectif + nom. Mpo na kozonga biloko oyo ezali na chambre, zongela 'with' (na): 'with a view' (na elongo), 'with breakfast' (na kolya ya ntango ya liboso).

concept_examples.text: I would like to book a double room for two nights.
concept_examples.translation: Nakómi nsé ya mobali ya chambre mibale mpo na biléyo mibale.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː tuː naɪts/

concept_examples.text: Do you have any rooms available for this weekend?
concept_examples.translation: Bazali na chambres oyo ezali na elongo mpo na week-end oyo?
concept_examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ˈɛni ruːmz əˈveɪləbəl fɔː ðɪs ˌwiːkˈɛnd/

concept_examples.text: I'd like a room with a sea view, please.
concept_examples.translation: Nakómi nsé ya mobali ya chambre na elongo ya nzoto, bondimi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk ə ruːm wɪð ə siː vjuː pliːz/

concept_examples.text: How much does it cost per night?
concept_examples.translation: Ezali nini likambo mpo na mobali?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ɪt kɒst pɜː naɪt/

common_error.wrong: I want reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct: I would like to reserve a room for two nights.
common_error.correct_alt: I'd like to book a room for two nights.
common_error.explanation: Na espanyol tozali koloba 'quiero reservar' na verbe 'querer', kasi na anglais 'want' ezali mpenza na kozala na lokumu na bobelema. Ezali mpenza na kozala na lokumu na 'would like' (nakómi nsé ya mobali/nazali na). Kasi na anglais na nsuka ya 'would like' tozali kozonga 'to' + verbe na infinitif: 'I would like to reserve'. Kosi koloba 'I want reserve' (na 'to'). Kozonga 'book' (kóma nsé) oyo ezali mpenza na kozala na lokumu na hôtels.

examples.original: Do you have a single room available?
examples.phonetic: /duː juː hæv ə ˈsɪŋɡəl ruːm əˈveɪləbəl/
examples.translation: Bazali na chambre moke oyo ezali na elongo?
examples.note: Zongela 'Do you have...?' mpo na kozonga na présent. 'Available' ezali na nsuka ya nom.

examples.original: Is there a room for tonight?
examples.translation: Ezali chambre mpo na biléyo oyo?
examples.note: Zongela 'Is there...?' mpo na kozonga elongo ya biloko.

examples.original: Are there any free rooms on Friday?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈɛni friː ruːmz ɒn ˈfraɪdeɪ/
examples.translation: Ezali chambres oyo ezali na elongo mpo na vendredi?
examples.note: Mpo na pluriel, zongela 'Are there any...?'. Kosala na mokili ete 'on' mpo na biléyo ya semaine.

examples.original: I'm sorry, we're fully booked.
examples.translation: Ndima, tozali na elongo ya ndenge nionso.
examples.note: Lokola mpo na kozonga ete ezali na elongo. 'Fully booked' eleki ete ezali na elongo ya ndenge nionso.

examples.original: I'd like to book a double room for three nights.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə bʊk ə ˈdʌbəl ruːm fɔː θriː naɪts/
examples.translation: Nakómi nsé ya mobali ya chambre mibale mpo na biléyo mibale.
examples.note: Zongela 'I'd like' (contracción ya 'would like') mpo na bobelema na lokumu.

examples.original: Can I reserve a room with a balcony?
examples.phonetic: /kæn aɪ rɪˈzɜːv ə ruːm wɪð ə ˈbælkəni/
examples.translation: Nakómi nsé ya mobali ya chambre na balcon?
examples.note: Zongela 'Can I...?' mpo na kozonga elongo. 'With' tozali kozonga mpo na kozonga biloko oyo ezali na chambre.

examples.original: My name is Ana García. I have a reservation.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ neɪm ɪz ˈɑːnə ɡɑːrˈsiːə aɪ hæv ə ˌrezəˈveɪʃən/
examples.translation: Nzoka na Ana García. Nazali na nsé.
examples.note: Tango ozali kokóma na hôtel, koloba nzoka na yo na ete ozali na nsé. 'Reservation' ezali motó oyo esili na espanyol.

examples.original: I need to cancel my reservation.
examples.translation: Nazali na mposa ya kosala nsé ya nsé.
examples.note: Zongela 'need to' + verbe mpo na kozonga mposa. 'Cancel' esili na espanyol.

levels.label: Questions about price and amenities
levels.translation: Mituna oyo eleki na likambo na biloko oyo ezali na chambre

examples.original: How much is it per night?
examples.translation: Ezali nini likambo mpo na mobali?
examples.note: Zongela 'How much' mpo na kozonga likambo. 'Per night' eleki 'mpo na mobali'.

examples.original: Does the price include breakfast?
examples.translation: Likambo eleki na kolya ya ntango ya liboso?
examples.note: Na personne mibale, tozali kozonga 'Does' mpo na kozonga. 'Include' esili na espanyol 'incluir'.

examples.original: Is Wi-Fi free?
examples.translation: Wi-Fi ezali ya solo?
examples.note: Na anglais, 'is' ezali na liboso ya sujet na mituna. 'Free' eleki 'ya solo' to 'ya solo'.

examples.original: What time is check-out?
examples.translation: Ezali nini ntango ya kosala check-out?
examples.note: Check-out ezali ntango ya kosala check-out, check-in ezali ntango ya kokóma. Tozali kozonga na ndenge ya nom.

title: At the Bank or Exchange Office / Na banki to na bureau ya change
bridge: Na anglais, mpo na kosila moko na ndenge malamu, tokosala na 'I would like...' to 'Can I...?', boye na español tokosala na 'Quisiera...' to '¿Me da...?'. Tosengeli kopesa makasi ete na anglais, ba verbes modaux 'can' na 'would' basili na forme ya base ya verbe, mpo na 'to', mpe ba expressions ya quantité koleka 'some' to 'any' bazongisi na ndenge ya phrase, ya soló, to ya kombo. Mpe na anglais, ba nombres na mbongo basengeli kosalema na ndenge moko: na yango, '100 dollars' ekomaka 'one hundred dollars', mpe ba décimaux basali na point, kasi na virgule.
rule: Mpo na kosala ba transactions na banki to na bureau ya change, bosengeli kosala ba phrases ya malamu na 'I would like' (nakoti) oyo esili na nom to 'to' + verbe na infinitif. Na yango: 'I would like to exchange dollars' (Nakoti na kozonga ba dollars). Mpe tokosala na 'Can I...?' (Nakoki...?) mpo na kolanda boye, koleka na 'Can I open an account?' (Nakoki kobenga compte moko?). Mpo na koyeba taux ya change, tokoyeba 'What is the exchange rate?' (Ndenge nini ya kozonga ezali?). Koyokana ete na anglais, ba noms ya kobenga mpe ya koyeba bazali na eloko moko oyo esili na 'some' (ya soló) mpe 'any' (ya kombo/kombo). Mpe ezali ya ntina eloko ya ba mots: na ba kombo, verbe ya kosala to ya koyeba esili liboso ya sujet. Mpo na koyeba ba quantités, sala na ba nombres ya cardinal mpe mbongo na nsuka, koleka 'fifty dollars' (makasi ya dollars).

concept_examples.text: I would like to exchange some dollars.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti na kozonga makasi ya dollars.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ sʌm ˈdɑːlərz/

concept_examples.text: What is the exchange rate?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini ya kozonga ezali?

concept_examples.text: Can I open a bank account?
concept_examples.translation: Nakoki kobenga compte ya banki moko?

concept_examples.text: I need to withdraw some money.
concept_examples.translation: Nalingi kozwa makasi ya mbongo.

common_error.correct_alt: I would like to change money.
common_error.explanation: Na español tokoyebi 'quiero cambiar dinero' mpo na préposition, kasi na anglais, ba verbes koleka 'want' na 'would like' basengeli 'to' liboso ya verbe na infinitif soki esili na verbe moko. Na yango, bosengeli koyeba 'I want to change...' to 'I would like to change...'. Bosalemi mpe na 'to' na nsuka ya 'want', oyo esalaka ndenge ya kozala na eloko moko. Koyokana ntina na kosala 'to' kati na verbe ya ntina na ya infinitif.

levels.label: Basic Phrases for Exchanging Money
levels.translation: Ba phrases ya ntango ya kozonga mbongo

examples.original: I would like to exchange euros for pounds.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd laɪk tuː ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˈjʊərəʊz fɔː paʊndz/
examples.translation: Nakoti na kozonga ba euros na ba livres.
examples.note: Sala na 'for' mpo na koyeba mbongo oyo olingi kozwa.

examples.original: What is the rate for dollars?
examples.translation: Ndenge nini ya kozonga ezali mpo na ba dollars?
examples.note: Koyeba taux ya change na 'rate'.

examples.original: Can I have some small bills?
examples.translation: Nakoki kopesa biso ba billets ya ndenge ya kasi?
examples.note: 'Small bills' ekomaka ba billets ya ndenge ya kasi.

examples.original: Is there a commission?
examples.translation: Kuna komision moko ezali?
examples.note: Na anglais, koyeba na 'Is there...?' mpo na eloko moko.

examples.original: I want to deposit this check into my account.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tuː dɪˈpɒzɪt ðɪs tʃek ˈɪntuː maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Nalingi kobenga cheque oyo na compte na ngai.
examples.note: Sala na 'into my account' mpo na koyeba koti mbongo ekoya.

examples.original: Can you withdraw money from my account?
examples.phonetic: /kæn juː wɪðˈdrɔː ˈmʌni frɒm maɪ əˈkaʊnt/
examples.translation: Nakoki kozwa mbongo na compte na ngai?
examples.note: 'Withdraw from' ezali préposition ya soló.

examples.original: How much is the service fee?
examples.translation: Ndenge nini ya kozala na tarife ya service?
examples.note: Koyeba prix na 'How much'.

examples.original: My account number is 12345.
examples.phonetic: /maɪ əˈkaʊnt ˈnʌmbər ɪz wʌn tuː θriː fɔː faɪv/
examples.translation: Numéro ya compte na ngai ezali 12345.
examples.note: Na anglais, ba nombres basalema na chiffre to na groupe.

examples.original: I need to transfer money online.
examples.translation: Nalingi kozonga mbongo na internet.
examples.note: Sala na 'online' mpo na koyeba ba opérations na internet.

examples.original: This is a currency exchange form.
examples.translation: Oyo ezali formulaire ya kozonga mbongo.
examples.note: 'Currency' ekomaka mbongo ya kati.

title: Job Interview Basics / Mokolo wa kosala mosala ya mbotama
bridge: Na mibongo ya kosala mosala o anglophone, boyokani ezali ndakisa mpe ya motoya. Na ndakisa ya lingala, tokosala te na 'tú' ya kokeleka to ya kobondela; nionso ezali 'you'. Kasi, ezali ya solo kotosa na présent simple po kozwa bato mpe passé simple po kozwa makambo oyo tokosala. Boye mpe, tokoki kotosa 'do/does' po kozwa boyokani, oyo na lingala ezali na elongo ya intonation to na '¿'.
rule: Po kozwa yo moko, tosalaka 'I am' (nzote/nzokande) mpe 'I have' (nalí). Po kozwa oyo ozali kosala, tosalaka présent simple: 'I work as...' (nazali kosala lokola...). Po kozwa makambo oyo osalaki na mbongo, tosalaka passé simple: 'I worked at...' (nalakaki na...). Boyokani ya solo ezali: 'What do you do?' (Ozali kosala nini?), 'Why do you want this job?' (Ndenge nini ozali koluka mosala oyo?), 'What are your strengths?' (Nzembe ya yo ezali nini?). Boye mpe, na anglais tokosala te sujet.

concept_examples.text: I am a student.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali etudiant.

concept_examples.text: I have experience in customer service.
concept_examples.translation: Nalí makasi na kosala na bato.

concept_examples.text: I worked at a restaurant.
concept_examples.translation: Nalakaki na restaurant.

concept_examples.text: Why do you want this job?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini ozali koluka mosala oyo?

common_error.explanation: Na lingala tosalaka 'nalí na 25 mwasi', kasi na anglais mwasi ezali na elongo ya verbe 'to be' (kozala) mpe te 'have' (nalí). Boye mpe, tokoki kobimisa traduction ya motoya.

examples.original: My name is Ana.
examples.translation: Nzokande Ana.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'my name is' po kobondela yo moko ya solo.

examples.original: I am from Mexico.
examples.translation: Nazali na Mexique.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'from' po kozwa esika ozali kotambola.

examples.original: I live in Madrid.
examples.translation: Nazali na Madrid.
examples.note: Kosalaka présent simple po kozwa makambo oyo ozali kosala na ntango nionso.

examples.original: I can speak English.
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba kozwa anglais.
examples.note: 'Can' ezali kozwa makasi, tokosala te 'sé' lokola na lingala.

examples.original: I am good at computers.
examples.translation: Nazali na makasi na ordinateur.
examples.note: Kosalaka 'good at' + nom to verbe -ing.

examples.original: I know how to use Excel.
examples.translation: Nazali koyeba ndenge ya kosala Excel.
examples.note: Structure 'know how to' + verbe.

examples.original: What are your strengths?
examples.translation: Nzembe ya yo ezali nini?
examples.note: Boyokani ya solo, komibola na 'I am...' to 'I can...'.

examples.original: Why do you want this job?
examples.translation: Ndenge nini ozali koluka mosala oyo?
examples.note: Kosalaka 'because' po kozwa mbala.

examples.original: I work well in a team.
examples.translation: Nazali kosala malamu na groupe.
examples.note: Kozwa nzembe na elongo ya adverbe.

translations.ln: Mokolo wa kosala mosala ya mbotama

title: At the post office / Na biro ya makasi
bridge: Na anglais, mpo na komonkezala malamu na biro ya makasi, tosilaka mabotami oyo ezali na lokota oyo ete 'I need to' to 'I'd like to', kasi na lingala tosilaka 'nazali na mposa' to 'nakoki'. Mbala mosusu, motuna 'send' ezali na lokota na 'to' mpo na komonisa kotambola (send something to someone), kasi na lingala tosilaka 'kotambola yango na motu'. Boye mpe, tala lisusu na esika ya motuna na mikolo oyo ezali na lokota 'How much does it cost?', kasi na lingala tosilaka 'Nsoni yango ezali na nguya?'.
rule: Mpo na kosolola na ntango ya A2 na anglais na nkombo ya makasi, tosilaka mabotami oyo: 1) 'I need to + motuna' (nazali na mposa + infinitif) mpo na komonisa mposa, pona ndakisa 'I need to send this package.' 2) 'I'd like to + motuna' (nakoki + infinitif) mpo na komonisa mposa na ntina, pona ndakisa 'I'd like to buy some stamps.' 3) 'How much is/are...?' mpe 'How much does it cost?' mpo na kopusa biloko, pona ndakisa 'How much is the shipping?' 4) Lokota 'to' na nsima ya motuna oyo ete 'send' mpe 'mail' mpo na komonisa motu, pona ndakisa 'Send it to my friend.' 5) Mikolo na 'where' mpe 'when' mpo na kopusa biloko ya komonisa, pona ndakisa 'Where can I pick up my package?' Boye mpe, tala lisusu ete na anglais, nkombo ezali na mbela ya motuna (registered mail), kasi na lingala ezali na nsima (makasi oyo ezali na elongo).

concept_examples.text: I need to send a letter to Spain.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na mposa kotambola letre mobimba na Espagne.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ə ˈlɛtər tə speɪn/

concept_examples.text: How much does this package cost to ship?
concept_examples.translation: Nsoni ezali na nguya kotambola paketa oyo?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ dʌz ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ kɒst tə ʃɪp/

concept_examples.text: I'd like to buy some stamps, please.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoki kobunga makasi mingi, svp.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə baɪ sʌm stæmps pliːz/

concept_examples.text: Where can I track my package?
concept_examples.translation: Wapi nakoki kozongisa paketa na ngai?

common_error.correct: How much does the shipping cost?
common_error.explanation: Seki ya mabe oyo ezali mpo na lingala tosilaka 'Nsoni yango ezali na nguya?', kasi na anglais mikolo oyo ezali na 'cost' ezali na mposa ya 'does' mpe motuna na ntango ya mbala. Tosilaka 'costs' na nsima ya 'does'. Mbala mosusu, tosilaka 'is' na esika ya 'cost'.

levels.label: Basic needs at the post office
levels.translation: Mposa ya mbala na biro ya makasi

examples.original: I need to buy some stamps.
examples.translation: Nazali na mposa kobunga makasi.
examples.note: Tosa 'need to' mpo na komonisa mposa. 'Stamps' ezali makasi.

examples.original: I'd like to send this package.
examples.translation: Nakoki kotambola paketa oyo.
examples.note: Tosa 'I'd like to' mpo na kosala ntina. 'Package' ezali paketa.

examples.original: Where is the post office?
examples.translation: Biro ya makasi ezali wapi?
examples.note: Kola mikolo na 'where' mpe motuna 'to be'.

levels.label: Asking about prices and services
levels.translation: Kopusa biloko ya nguya mpe ya komonisa

examples.original: How much is the shipping to Mexico?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə ˈʃɪpɪŋ tə ˈmɛksɪkoʊ/
examples.translation: Nsoni ezali na nguya kotambola yango na Mexique?
examples.note: Tosa 'How much is' mpo na kopusa biloko.

examples.original: I need to send this by registered mail.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ niːd tə sɛnd ðɪs baɪ ˈrɛdʒɪstərd meɪl/
examples.translation: Nazali na mposa kotambola yango na makasi oyo ezali na elongo.
examples.note: 'Registered mail' ezali makasi oyo ezali na elongo. Nkombo ezali na mbela ya motuna.

examples.original: Can I track my package online?
examples.translation: Nakoki kozongisa paketa na ngai na internet?
examples.note: Tosa modal 'can' mpo na kopusa soki ezali possible.

examples.original: I want to send this box to my friend in Colombia.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə sɛnd ðɪs bɒks tə maɪ frɛnd ɪn kəˈlɒmbiə/
examples.translation: Nakoki kotambola bokolo oyo na moninga na ngai na Colombie.
examples.note: Tosa 'to' mpo na komonisa motu mpe 'in' mpo na mokolo.

examples.original: This package is too big for the mailbox.
examples.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpækɪdʒ ɪz tuː bɪg fɔr ðə ˈmeɪlbɒks/
examples.translation: Paketa oyo ezali mingi mpenza mpo na boite.
examples.note: Tosa 'too + nkombo' mpo na komonisa mposa ya mingi.

examples.original: What is the delivery time to the United States?
examples.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə dɪˈlɪvəri taɪm tə ðə juˈnaɪtɪd steɪts/
examples.translation: Nsoni ezali na nguya kotambola yango na Etats-Unis?
examples.note: Kola mikolo na 'what' mpo na kopusa biloko ya mbala.

title: Renting a Flat / Kokáta mosálá
bridge: Na español, po na kosolola ntango ekokáta mosálá to esálá mosálá, topesaka 'alquilar' to 'rentar', mpe po na koloba ete mosálá ezali ya kokáta, topesaka 'está libre' to 'se alquila'. Na anglais, topesaka 'rent' po na verba mpe po na nomo ya sustantivo ('rent' = kokáta), mpe 'available' to 'for rent' po na komonisa ete ezali ya kokáta. Boya mokolo na préposition: na anglais topesaka 'rent an apartment' (kozonga préposition), kasi na español mbala mosuso topesaka 'alquilar un piso'. Mpe na anglais, bato oyo basálá biloko ya kosolola basalaka eloko oyo ezali na structure ya passif 'is for rent' to 'is available', likambo oyo na español ezali na 'se alquila' to 'está disponible'.
rule: Po na kosolola ntango ekokáta mosálá na anglais na niveau ya A2, boye kozala na bato oyo oyebi: (1) Verbe 'to rent' (kokáta) mpe biloko naye: rent / rents / renting / rented. (2) Préposition 'for' na kombinasion na nomo ya 'rent' po na komonisa ete eloko ezali ya kokáta: 'for rent' (ya kokáta). (3) Nomo ya adjectif 'available' (ezali ya kokáta) po na koloba ete mosálá ezali ya kokáta. (4) Mots ya clé: 'apartment' (mosálá/ appartement), 'flat' (mosálá, ezali ya molai na anglais ya britannique), 'landlord' (moyibi ya mosálá/mokokáti), 'tenant' (moyibi ya mosálá), 'deposit' (garantie/depôt), 'rent' (kokáta ya mois), 'lease' (contrat ya kokáta). (5) Po na kosola ntango ekokáta mosálá, usa 'How much is the rent?' (Ndenge nini ezali kokáta?) mpe 'Is it furnished?' (Ezali na biloko ya koyeba?). Na ntango ya structure, boya mokolo ete na anglais adjectifs ezali liboso ya nomo: 'a small apartment', kasi 'an apartment small'.

concept_examples.text: I want to rent an apartment near the city center.
concept_examples.translation: Nakoti kokáta appartement moko oyo ezali liboso ya ville.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒnt tə rent ən əˈpɑːrtmənt nɪr ðə ˈsɪti ˈsɛntər/

concept_examples.text: How much is the rent per month?
concept_examples.translation: Ndenge nini ezali kokáta ya mois moko?
concept_examples.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðə rɛnt pər mʌnθ/

concept_examples.text: The apartment is available for rent.
concept_examples.translation: Appartement ezali ya kokáta.

concept_examples.text: The landlord requires a deposit of one month's rent.
concept_examples.translation: Moyibi ya mosálá akotya depôt ya mois moko ya kokáta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈlændlɔrd rɪˈkwaɪərz ə dɪˈpɑzɪt əv wʌn mʌnθs rɛnt/

common_error.wrong: I need to rent a flat for center.
common_error.correct: I need to rent a flat near the center.
common_error.correct_alt: I need to rent a flat in the city center.
common_error.explanation: Seki ya mabe ezali kosalaka 'for' na esika ya 'near' to 'in' ntango ozali koloba esika. Na español topesaka 'para el centro' to 'por el centro', kasi na anglais, 'for' ezali po na butu to mbongo, kasi po na esika. Po na kosolola esika oyo ezali liboso, topesaka 'near' (liboso ya) to 'in the city center' (na ville). Boya mokolo kozonga préposition 'por' to 'para' na ndenge ya motuya.

examples.original: apartment
examples.translation: appartement / mosálá
examples.note: Na anglais ya américain topesaka 'apartment'; na anglais ya britannique 'flat' ezali ya molai. Mibali mibali ezali ya bon.

examples.original: rent (noun)
examples.translation: kokáta (ya mois)
examples.note: Na esika ya nomo, 'rent' ezali mbongo oyo ozali kopesa mois na mois. Boya mokolo kozonga na verba 'rent' (kokáta).

examples.original: landlord
examples.translation: moyibi ya mosálá / mokokáti
examples.note: Na anglais, forme ya femme ezali 'landlady', kasi 'landlord' ezali ya molai po na mibali mibali.

examples.original: deposit
examples.translation: garantie / depôt
examples.note: Ezali mbongo oyo ozali koyoka na garantie. Na ndenge ya normal ezali kopesa mpe na esika ya kozala na eloko oyo ezali ya mabe.

examples.original: How many bedrooms does the apartment have?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɛdrumz dʌz ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt hæv/
examples.translation: Chambres combien ezali na appartement?
examples.note: Boya mokolo ete na anglais questions na 'how many' ezali po na biloko oyo ezali ya kobakisa (chambres).

examples.original: Is the rent included in the price?
examples.phonetic: /ɪz ðə rɛnt ɪnˈkludɪd ɪn ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Kokáta ezali na ndaku ya prix?
examples.note: Kuna 'rent' ezali kokáta ya mois, mpe 'price' ezali total to coût ya mawa.

examples.original: When can I move in?
examples.translation: Ntango nini nakoki koyekola?
examples.note: Expression 'move in' ezali 'koyekola na esika ya sika'.

examples.original: The apartment is furnished, but the kitchen is small.
examples.phonetic: /ðə əˈpɑːrtmənt ɪz ˈfɜːrnɪʃt bʌt ðə ˈkɪtʃən ɪz smɔl/
examples.translation: Appartement ezali na biloko ya koyeba, kasi cuisine ezali ya sika.
examples.note: Usa 'but' (kasi) po na kozonga biloko ya bon mpe ya mabe.

examples.original: Can you lower the rent?
examples.translation: Nakoki kobatela kokáta?
examples.note: Verbe 'lower' ezali 'kobatela', na ndenge ya spécial na prix to quantité.

examples.original: I'd like to sign a lease for one year.
examples.phonetic: /aɪd laɪk tə saɪn ə lis fɔr wʌn jɪr/
examples.translation: Nakoti kosala contrat ya kokáta ya année moko.
examples.note: Contracción 'I'd like' ezali na esika ya 'I would like', mpe na español ezali 'me gustaría'.

title: Making small talk at a party / Kɔlɔ́kɔ na mokili ya ntango ya kɔlɔ́kɔ
bridge: Na espanyolí, tango oyo tozali kopesa mokili, tokɔlɔ́kɔ́ na lokola '¿Qué tal?' to '¿Cómo estás?' mpe tokosala na verba 'estar' mpo na makambo oyo ezali na ntango moke. Na anglé, tozali kosala 'How are you?' kasi mpe lokuta lokola 'How's it going?' to 'What's up?' oyo ezali ya solo na makambo oyo ezali na ntango moke. Kolinga ete na anglé tokosala te 'estoy de acuerdo' na ndakisa ya 'I am agree' (mbongo oyo ezali na ntango moke), kasi 'I agree'. Mpe, biloko oyo tozali kosala na 'How are you?' ezali ya solo mpe ya mawa, lokola 'I'm good, thanks', ata soki ezali ya solo te, na ndakisa ya makambo oyo tozali kosala na espanyolí.
rule: Mpo na kosala kɔlɔ́kɔ na mokili ya ntango ya kɔlɔ́kɔ, kosala makambo oyo ezali ya solo lokola 'Hey, how's it going?' to 'What's up?' (biloko: 'Not much, you?'). Mpo na kopesa ndako,  koloba 'I'm [name], nice to meet you'. Mpo na kopesa moko moko, kosala 'Would you like something to drink?' (nzela ya mawa) to 'Do you want a drink?' (ya solo). Mpo na koloba makambo oyo ozali na yango, kosala 'I like...' / 'I don't like...'. Mpo na koloba ete ozali na yango, kolinga ete verba ezali 'agree' (te 'be agree'): 'I agree with you'. Biloko oyo tozali kosala na 'How are you?' ezali ya solo mpe ya mawa: 'I'm good', 'I'm fine', 'Pretty good'. Mpo na kobimisa, kosala 'It was nice talking to you' to 'See you later'.

concept_examples.text: Hi, I'm Maria. Nice to meet you.
concept_examples.translation: Mbote, na María. Nzete ya kolandaka yo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm məˈriːə naɪs tə miːt juː/

concept_examples.text: How's it going?
concept_examples.translation: Makambo na yo ezali nini?

concept_examples.text: Would you like something to drink?
concept_examples.translation: Ozali na boyo mpo na kosala moke moke?

concept_examples.text: I agree with you, this party is great.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na yango na yo, mokili oyo ezali ya solo.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ əˈɡriː wɪð juː ðɪs ˈpɑːrti ɪz ɡreɪt/

common_error.explanation: Mbongo ezali na kopesa 'estoy de acuerdo' na ndakisa ya verba 'to be' (ezali). Na anglé, 'agree' ezali verba ya solo, te adjéctif, mpo na yango tokosala te na 'be'. Mpo na kozonga yango, kolinga ete 'agree' tokosala na verba 'do' na biloko oyo ezali te mpe na biloko oyo ezali na yango: 'I don't agree', 'Do you agree?'.

levels.label: Greetings and Introductions
levels.translation: Makambo oyo tozali kosala mpe kopesa ndako

examples.original: Hey, I'm John. What's your name?
examples.translation: Mbote, na John. Nzete ya kolandaka yo, ozali na nani?
examples.note: Kosala 'What's your name?' mpo na koposa ndako, kasi ezali ya solo na makambo oyo ezali na ntango moke koleka 'What is your name?'.

examples.original: Nice to meet you, too.
examples.translation: Nzete ya kolandaka yo mpe na yo.
examples.note: Kosala 'too' na nsuka mpo na kosala makambo oyo moko moko azali na yango.

examples.original: This is my friend, Ana.
examples.translation: Oyo ezali moninga na ngai, Ana.
examples.note: Na kopesa ndako, 'This is...' ezali ya solo mpo na kopesa moko moko.

examples.original: Can I get you a drink?
examples.translation: Nakoki kopesa yo moke moke?
examples.note: 'Can I...' ezali ya solo mpe ya ntango moke. 'May I...' ezali ya mawa.

examples.original: Would you like some snacks?
examples.translation: Ozali na boyo mpo na kosala moke moke ya kolya?
examples.note: Kosala 'some' na kopesa, te 'any'.

examples.original: Could you pass me the chips, please?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd juː pæs miː ðə tʃɪps pliːz/
examples.translation: Ozali na boyo mpo na kopesa ngai makasi, svp?
examples.note: 'Could' ezali ya mawa koleka 'can' mpo na koposa makasi.

examples.original: Wow, this is fun!
examples.translation: Wow, oyo ezali ya solo!
examples.note: Kosala 'Wow' mpo na kosala ete ozali na yango.

examples.original: I really like this music.
examples.translation: Nazali na yango mpenza na musika oyo.
examples.note: Kota 'really' liboso ya verba mpo na kosala ete ozali na yango.

examples.original: It was nice talking to you. See you later!
examples.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz naɪs ˈtɔːkɪŋ tə juː siː juː ˈleɪtər/
examples.translation: Ezali ya solo koloba na yo. Tembe!
examples.note: Mpo na kobimisa, kosala 'It was nice talking to you' mpe apesaka 'See you later' lokola kobimisa ya ntango moke.

examples.original: I have to go now. Thanks for having me!
examples.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tə ɡoʊ naʊ θæŋks fər hævɪŋ miː/
examples.translation: Nazali na boyo mpo na yanga. Merci mpo na kopesa ngai ndako!
examples.note: Kosala merci na moninga na 'Thanks for having me'.

translations.ln: Na mokili to na kɔlɔ́kɔ ya ntango

title: Complaining and Apologizing / Kɔbɔla na kosolola
bridge: Na español, mbala nyingi ozali kosolola na 'lo siento' to 'perdón', kasi na anglais ezali mabotami: 'I'm sorry' ezali na bosɔtɛ mɔtɛmɔtɛ mpenza to ya motoya, mpe 'excuse me' ezali kotɛka bosɔtɛ to kosolola na ntango olingi kokanisa muntu to kosolola na bosɔtɛ ya ndenge moke. Mpe na kobɔla, anglais mbala nyingi azali kosalela présent simple na 'can't' to 'won't' kobimisa bosɛki, kasi na español ozali koloba 'no puedo' to 'no quiere' na ndenge moke mpe mobimba. Boye kobɛla na likambo ya motanda ya bazo oyo ezali na 'to' sima ya nkombo ya nguya oyo ezali na 'sorry'.
rule: Kobɔla na anglais, ozali kosalela bato oyo ezali na 'I can't + verbe' (sokí te) to 'This is + adjectif' (oyo ezali + adjectif). Kosolola, salela 'I'm sorry (for) + gérondif' to 'I apologize for + nom'. Boye 'sorry' ezali na 'for' soki ozali koloba mambe (I'm sorry for being late). Na mikolo ya makasi, 'I apologize' ezali makasi mpenza. Kobima bisoló, ozali koloba 'It's okay', 'No problem', to 'That's fine'. Salela te 'I'm sorry' kobɛta likambo (salela 'excuse me').

concept_examples.text: I'm sorry for being late.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali na bosɔtɛ mpo nazali koka na ntango.

concept_examples.text: This is really annoying.
concept_examples.translation: Oyo ezali mɔtɛmɔtɛ mpenza bosɛki.

concept_examples.text: I can't find my keys.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kobɛta bankey na ngai.

concept_examples.text: Excuse me, could you help me?
concept_examples.translation: Solola, ozali kosala ngai?

common_error.wrong: I am sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct: I'm sorry, but I have a problem.
common_error.correct_alt: Excuse me, I have a problem.
common_error.explanation: Na anglais ya lolenge, 'I'm' ezali mbala nyingi mpenza na ndako ya 'I am' na makambo. Kosalela 'I am' ezali kokamba makasi mpenza. Mpe kobɔla na ndenge moke, bakonzi ya español mbala nyingi bazali kosalela 'I am sorry' ata soki bazali kosolola te, kasi na anglais bazali kosalela 'excuse me' kobɛta likambo ntango bazali kobɔla.

examples.original: I'm sorry.
examples.translation: Nazali na bosɔtɛ.
examples.note: Ezali kosalema na bisoló na ndenge moke. Na español, 'lo siento' ezali mpe mbala nyingi, kasi na anglais bazali kosalela mpenza.

examples.original: I apologize.
examples.translation: Nazali kosolola.
examples.note: Ezali makasi mpenza na ndako ya 'I'm sorry'. Salela yango na mikolo ya makasi to na bato oyo oyebi te.

examples.original: Sorry about that.
examples.translation: Solola mpo na oyo.
examples.note: Ezali ya ndenge moke mpe ya lolenge. Bazali kosalela na baninga to na mikolo ya ndenge moke.

examples.original: I can't stand the noise.
examples.translation: Nazali na bosɛki mpenza mpo na mbɔsa.
examples.note: 'Can't stand' ezali molongo moke mpo na kobimisa bosɛki. Na español ozali kosalela 'no soporto', oyo ezali ya ndenge moke.

examples.original: This is not what I ordered.
examples.translation: Oyo ezali te oyo nazali kosala.
examples.note: Ezali mpo na biloko to botique. Salela passé simple 'ordered' mpo na koloba oyo ozali kosala.

examples.original: The service is too slow.
examples.translation: Mokano ezali mpenza ya ntango.
examples.note: 'Too + adjectif' eleki 'mpenza', ya ndenge moke na 'demasiado' na español.

examples.original: I've been waiting for an hour.
examples.translation: Nazali kosala mokano ya sawa na awa.
examples.note: Salela présent parfait continu mpo na koloba oyo ezali kokoma. Na español, ozali koloba 'llevo esperando una hora'.

examples.original: It's okay.
examples.translation: Ezali malamu.
examples.note: Mokano ya ndenge moke mpo na kobima bisoló. Na español, ozali koloba 'está bien' to 'no pasa nada'.

examples.original: No problem.
examples.translation: Kuna problem te.
examples.note: Mbala nyingi na anglais ya amerika. Ya ndenge moke na 'no hay problema' na español.

examples.original: That's all right.
examples.translation: Ezali likambo te.
examples.note: Mokano moke mpo na koloba 'ezali malamu', kasi ezali makasi mpenza. Na español, 'no importa' ezali ya ndenge moke.

examples.original: Don't worry about it.
examples.translation: Boye kozonga te mpo na oyo.
examples.note: Bazali kosalela mpo na kozonga muntu oyo azali kosolola. Ya ndenge moke na 'no te preocupes' na español.

title: Describing your hometown / Komona yango ozali kosala na mboka na yo
bridge: Na anglais, po komona mboka na yo, ozali kosala na verba 'to be' po koloba nini ezali (big, small, quiet) mpe 'there is/there are' po kozongisa ba endroits. Na español, ozali koloba 'es grande' to 'hay un parque', kasi na anglais boya kolinga 'there is' ezali pona moke mpe 'there are' pona bato. Kosi okati ya ba motoya ezali ya nguya: liboso sujet mpe sima verba, lokola na 'My city is big'. Bana oyo bazali koyekola español bazali mingi kobimisa kosala na 'there is/are' to bazali koyeka adjectif na nsima ya substantif, lokola 'the city big' na esika ya 'the big city'.
rule:
Po komona mboka na yo na anglais na niveau A2, sala na ba modèles oyo:

1. **Sujet + verba 'to be' (am/is/are) + adjectif**: Komona ba caractéristiques générales. Exemple: 'My town is small.' (Mboka na ngai ezali ya moke).
   - Na ba pronoms: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are.
   - Ba adjectifs bazali koyekama liboso ya substantif soki bazali kobongisa: 'a big city', te 'a city big'.

2. **There is / There are**: Po koloba ete kuna kuna ezali na mboka na yo.
   - There is + substantif moke/contable oyo ezali te ya kobondela: 'There is a park.' (Ezali kuna kuna parc moko).
   - There are + substantif bato: 'There are two schools.' (Ezali kuna kuna ba écoles mibale).
   - Na négatif: There isn't / There aren't: 'There isn't a cinema.' (Ezali kuna kuna cinéma te).
   - Na ba questions: Is there...? Are there...? (Ezali kuna kuna...?).

3. **Ba prépositions ya ba endroits**: Po kozonga ba endroits.
   - 'in the center' (na centre), 'on the corner' (na coin), 'near' (kuna na), 'next to' (kuna na).

4. **Ba verbes ya ba actions**: 'You can see', 'you can find', 'there is' mpe ezali kosalema pona koloba 'on peut trouver'.

5. **Ba connecteurs**: Sala na 'and' po koyokana ba idées mpe 'but' po kopesa contraste: 'My town is small but beautiful.' (Mboka na ngai ezali ya moke kasi ezali ya nguya).

Po A2, tika ba phrases ya moke mpe ya mokili. Boya kolinga ete 'there is' na bato ezali 'there are' – koloba te 'there is many shops'.

concept_examples.text: My city is big and modern.
concept_examples.translation: Mboka na ngai ezali ya nguya mpe moderne.

concept_examples.text: There is a beautiful park in the center.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna parc moko ya nguya na centre.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈbjuːtɪfʊl pɑːrk ɪn ðə ˈsentər/

concept_examples.text: There are two small shops near my house.
concept_examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna ba boutiques mibale ya moke kuna na maison na ngai.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː tuː smɔːl ʃɒps nɪər maɪ haʊs/

concept_examples.text: My town is quiet, but it's very friendly.
concept_examples.translation: Mboka na ngai ezali ya kalem, kasi ezali ya nguya mingi.
concept_examples.phonetic: /maɪ taʊn ɪz ˈkwaɪət bʌt ɪts ˈveri ˈfrendli/

common_error.correct_alt: There is a church in my town.
common_error.explanation: Soki okomi na erreur, ezali kosala na 'have' na troisième personne singulier (he/she/it). Na anglais, pona 'town' (it) boya kosala na 'has'. Kosi bana oyo bazali koyekola bazali kobimisa 'there is' mpe bazali kosala na 'have' lokola na español 'mi pueblo tiene una iglesia'. Na anglais, pona existence, ezali ya nguya mingi kosala na 'there is' kolinga 'to have'.

levels.label: Talking about size and character
levels.translation: Koloba nini ezali na taille mpe na caractère

examples.original: My city is very big.
examples.translation: Mboka na ngai ezali ya nguya mingi.
examples.note: Sala na 'very' po kopesa force na adjectif, lokola 'muy grande' na español.

examples.original: It is small and quiet.
examples.translation: Ezali ya moke mpe ya kalem.
examples.note: Boya kolinga ete 'quiet' eleki koloba ya kalem (ezali te na bruit), te 'quite' (mingi).

examples.original: The city is busy in the morning.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪti ɪz ˈbɪzi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːrnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Mboka ezali na mingi na makasi.
examples.note: Na anglais, pona komona ba caractéristiques ya kokoka, tosali na 'is', kasi 'busy' eleki kozala ya mokolo moko; awa eleki koloba nini ezali na nguya.

levels.label: Describing places with 'there is' and 'there are'

examples.original: There is a museum and a library.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə mjuːˈziːəm ænd ə ˈlaɪbrəri/
examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna musée moko mpe bibliothèque moko.
examples.note: Soki ozali koyokana ba choses mingi, sala na 'there is' pona liboso to soki bazali te ya kobondela, kasi na bato tosali na 'there are'.

examples.original: There are many restaurants in the main square.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑː ˈmeni ˈrestərɒnts ɪn ðə meɪn skweər/
examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna ba restaurants mingi na place principale.
examples.note: Sala na 'many' na ba pluraux ya kobondela, lokola 'muchos restaurantes'.

examples.original: Is there a supermarket near here?
examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna supermarché moko kuna na awa?
examples.note: Po kozwa, boya kozonga: 'Is there...?'

examples.original: There aren't any museums in my town.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni mjuːˈziːəmz ɪn maɪ taʊn/
examples.translation: Ezali kuna kuna ba musées te na mboka na ngai.
examples.note: Sala na 'aren't any' po kopesa négatif na bato; 'there isn't' pona moke.

levels.label: Giving opinions and recommendations
levels.translation: Kopesa ba avis mpe ba recommandations

examples.original: I love my city because it's beautiful.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv maɪ ˈsɪti bɪkəz ɪts ˈbjuːtɪfʊl/
examples.translation: Nakoti mboka na ngai mpo ezali ya nguya.
examples.note: Sala na 'because' po kopesa raison, lokola 'porque' na español.

examples.original: You should visit the old castle.
examples.translation: Boyei kozwa château ya zonga.
examples.note: Sala na 'should' po kopesa recommandation; na español 'deberías'.

examples.original: It's a great place to live.
examples.translation: Ezali eloko ya nguya po kozala.
examples.note: 'A great place' eleki koloba eloko ya nguya; sala na 'live' (kozala) na 'in' na nsima te.

translations.ln: Komona yango ozali kosala na mboka na yo

title: Talking About Hobbies / Kozonga mpo na bangogo na ntango ya mokolo ekobima
bridge: Na espanyol, po kozonga mpo na bangogo to bangogo ya mokolo ekobima, tokosala ba verbes lokola 'gustar' to 'encantar' na pronome ya mbula ndaku (lokola 'me gusta', 'te gusta'), mpe tokoyeba mingi 'me gusta + infinitif'. Na anglais, verbe 'like' esalema na ndenge moko mpe direct: 'I like + -ing' to 'I like + to + verbe'. Mpe kaka mposa ya mibeko, na anglais, tokosala te artikulo na ba jour ya semaine na ba phrases lokola 'on Mondays' (bandako 'los lunes' na espanyol), mpe tokoyeba 'los lunes'. Mpe na anglais, tokosala 'do' po kozwa mpo na ba activités ('What do you do in your free time?'), kaka tozali koyeba na espanyol '¿Qué haces en tu tiempo libre?'.
rule: Po kozonga mpo na bangogo na anglais (niveau A2): sala ba verbes 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' to 'prefer' na sima ya substantif to verbe na forme -ing (lokola 'I like music', 'I love playing soccer'). Mpe tokosala 'be interested in' + substantif to forme -ing (lokola 'I'm interested in photography'). Po kozwa, sala 'What do you like doing?' to 'What do you do in your free time?'. Po kozwa mpo na fréquence, sala ba adverbes lokola 'always', 'usually', 'sometimes', 'never' liboso ya verbe principal (lokola 'I usually read'). Mpe tokosala ba prépositions 'in' (in my free time), 'on' (on weekends, on Mondays) mpe 'at' (at home, at the weekend – na anglais britannique). Boye: kosala te 'do' na 'like' na présent simple po ba affirmations (tozali koyeba 'I like', te 'I do like' kaka tozali kolanda kozwa).

concept_examples.text: I like listening to music.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kozua mingi koseka musika.

concept_examples.text: She loves playing tennis.
concept_examples.translation: Ye azali kozua mingi kosala tennis.

concept_examples.text: What do you do in your free time?
concept_examples.translation: Oyebi kozala nini na ntango ya mokolo ekobima na yo?
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt duː juː duː ɪn jɔː friː taɪm/

concept_examples.text: I usually go hiking on weekends.
concept_examples.translation: Na bandako, nazali kobima na weekend.

common_error.explanation: Soki tokomi na mposa ya mibeko ezali mpo na espanyol tozali koyeba 'me gusta jugar' na infinitif, mpe ba étudiants bazali koyekola yango na anglais. Kasi, na anglais, na sima ya 'like', 'love', 'enjoy' etc., tozali kosala forme -ing to kaka na ba cas na 'to' (kasi te infinitif moko te). Po kozala na mposa ya mibeko, boye: na sima ya 'like', sala forme -ing: 'I like playing'. Mpe tokoki kosala 'I like to play', kasi ezali mawa te.

levels.label: Talking About What You Like
levels.translation: Kozonga mpo na nini ozali kozua

examples.original: I love reading books.
examples.translation: Nazali kozua mingi kosala ba livres.
examples.note: Sala 'love' + -ing po kozwa mpo na bangogo ya kozua mingi. Na espanyol tozali kosala 'encantar'.

examples.original: She enjoys painting.
examples.translation: Ye azali kozua kosala peinture.
examples.note: 'Enjoy' ezali na sima ya -ing. Tozali koyeba te 'enjoy to paint'.

examples.original: I don't like cooking.
examples.translation: Nazali kozua te kosala cuisine.
examples.note: Po kozwa mpo na négation, sala 'don't' + like + -ing. Na espanyol: 'no me gusta'.

levels.label: Asking Others About Hobbies
levels.translation: Kozwa ba autres mpo na bangogo na bango

examples.original: What do you like doing?
examples.translation: Oyebi kozala nini kozua kosala?
examples.note: Ezali ndenge moko mpe mawa mpe mawa ya kozwa mpo na bangogo. Na espanyol: '¿Qué te gusta hacer?'

examples.original: Do you play any sports?
examples.translation: Oyebi kosala sport?
examples.note: Sala 'play' na ba sports ya équipe (play football, play tennis). Na espanyol: 'jugar'.

examples.original: How often do you go to the cinema?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɒfən duː juː ɡəʊ tə ðə ˈsɪnəmə/
examples.translation: Oyebi kozala na cinéma na fréquence nini?
examples.note: Na espanyol tozali kosala 'ir al cine' na 'a'; na anglais tozali kosala 'go to + lieu'.

levels.label: Expressing Frequency and Preferences
levels.translation: Kozwa mpo na fréquence mpe bangogo

examples.original: I often watch TV in the evening.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɒfən wɒtʃ ˌtiːˈviː ɪn ðə ˈiːvnɪŋ/
examples.translation: Na bandako, nazali koseka télévision na soir.
examples.note: Ba adverbes ya fréquence (often, usually, always) bazali liboso ya verbe principal. Na espanyol tozali koyeba 'a menudo'.

examples.original: I prefer playing video games to reading.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ prɪˈfɜː ˈpleɪɪŋ ˈvɪdiəʊ ɡeɪmz tə ˈriːdɪŋ/
examples.translation: Nazali kozua mingi kosala ba jeux vidéo koleka kosala lecture.
examples.note: Po kozwa mpo na bangogo, sala 'prefer A to B', na ba options mibale na -ing. Na espanyol: 'prefiero X a Y'.

examples.original: On Sundays, I usually go for a walk.
examples.phonetic: /ɒn ˈsʌndeɪz aɪ ˈjuːʒuəli ɡəʊ fər ə wɔːk/
examples.translation: Na dimanche, na bandako nazali kobima.
examples.note: Sala 'on' na ba jours ya semaine na pluriel. Na espanyol tozali koyeba 'los domingos'.

translations.ln: Kozonga mpo na bangogo na ntango ya mokolo ekobima
